sources.name: NASA Orion spacecraft
sources.note: Crew capsule scale (four crew, about 9 t crew module).

sources.name: NASA Curiosity rover (MSL)
sources.note: Rover mass (about 0.9 t) and the on-board Sample Analysis at Mars lab.

sources.name: NASA Radioisotope Power Systems
sources.note: RTGs give steady power from plutonium-238 decay, independent of sunlight; heavy per watt compared with solar.

sources.name: NASA Small Spacecraft Technology: Power
sources.note: Solar arrays, batteries and power budgets.

sources.name: Game values
sources.note: Masses, costs, power draws and the 0–10 science, crew support, protection and comms ratings are simplified game estimates inspired by real hardware.

modules.name: Crew Capsule
modules.requiresPowerNote: Air and heat for the crew use 2 kW, day and night.
modules.blurb: Carries 4 astronauts, like NASA's Orion capsule. Add it to send people.

modules.name: Robot Probe
modules.requiresPowerNote: Its computer and electronics use 0.2 kW.
modules.blurb: A computer flies the spacecraft, with no astronauts. Much lighter than the Crew Capsule.

modules.name: Lander
modules.requiresPowerNote: Its landing radar and heaters use 0.3 kW.
modules.blurb: Legs, an engine and radar for landing on the Moon or Mars.

modules.name: Sample Return Capsule
modules.requiresPowerNote: No power needed.
modules.blurb: Brings rock samples back to Earth, for the best labs. Its science counts only when it lands on Earth.

modules.name: Small Solar Panels
modules.requiresPowerNote: Makes less power where there is less sunlight.
modules.blurb: Makes 1.5 kW near Earth.

modules.name: Large Solar Panels
modules.requiresPowerNote: Makes less power where there is less sunlight.
modules.blurb: Makes 6 kW near Earth. Big panels, big power.

modules.name: Nuclear Battery (RTG)
modules.requiresPowerNote: Steady power. It does not need sunlight.
modules.blurb: An RTG. Heat from plutonium makes power day and night. It works far from the Sun and in dust storms. Heavy for its power.

modules.name: Extra Batteries
modules.requiresPowerNote: Gives 0.5 kW when there is no sunlight.
modules.blurb: Stores power for nights and dust storms. It does not make new power.

modules.name: Rock Scanner
modules.requiresPowerNote: Uses 0.05 kW.
modules.blurb: A spectrometer. It studies light to find out what rocks are made of.

modules.name: Drill
modules.requiresPowerNote: Uses a lot of power: 0.4 kW.
modules.blurb: Digs under the surface. Ice and signs of life may be safe from radiation there.

modules.name: Quake Sensor
modules.requiresPowerNote: Uses 0.02 kW.
modules.blurb: A seismometer. It feels quakes to learn what is deep inside, like NASA's InSight lander on Mars.

modules.name: HD Cameras
modules.requiresPowerNote: Uses 0.03 kW.
modules.blurb: Sharp colour cameras. They make maps, help you find your way and share the view.

modules.name: Mini Science Lab
modules.requiresPowerNote: Its ovens and pumps use 0.8 kW.
modules.blurb: A small lab that tests samples right there, like the lab on NASA's Curiosity rover.

modules.name: Small Antenna
modules.requiresPowerNote: Uses 0.05 kW.
modules.blurb: Works from any angle, but it sends data home slowly.

modules.name: Big Antenna
modules.requiresPowerNote: Uses 0.2 kW to send data.
modules.blurb: A dish that points at Earth. It sends all your science home and keeps contact in bad conditions.

modules.name: Radiation Shield
modules.requiresPowerNote: No power needed.
modules.blurb: Layers of plastic and water that block radiation from the Sun. Add 1 for light protection, or 2 for heavy protection.

modules.name: Spare Parts Kit
modules.requiresPowerNote: No power needed.
modules.blurb: Extra wheels, valves and computer boards. When something breaks, you can fix it.

modules.name: Backup Computer
modules.requiresPowerNote: Uses 0.1 kW.
modules.blurb: A second flight computer. It takes over at once if the first one fails.

modules.name: Rover
modules.requiresPowerNote: Charges from your power: 0.3 kW.
modules.blurb: A robot car, like NASA's Curiosity. It drives to new places to find more science.

modules.name: Habitat
modules.requiresPowerNote: Heat, air and clean water use 3 kW.
modules.blurb: A home for astronauts on long trips. It has a medical room, and water in its walls blocks radiation.
